paite: Josiah alal pat tung in kum giat a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-khat alal a; anu min Jedidah, Boskath a Adaiah tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Josiah / (2 Kro 34.1,2)
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil dik ahih a, apu David lampi tot tengteng atawn a, taklam ah hiam veilam ah hiam apialkhe kei hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

paite: Kumpipa Josiah alal kum sawm-le-giatna kum in hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa'n Meshullam tapa Azaliah tapa laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah,
heading: Dan Laibu Muhkhiakna / (2 Kro 34.8-28)
english: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to Yahweh’s house, saying,

paite: "Siampu lianpen Hilkiah kiang ah hohtou inla, kongkhak veng mite'n mite a pan ana lakkhawm uh TOUPA' inn a dangka kikoih sim uhenla;
english: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which is brought into Yahweh’s house, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people.

paite: TOUPA' inn lam nasem mite pia uhen; amau inn se bawl TOUPA' inn a nasemte pia uhen.
english: Let them deliver it into the hand of the workers who have the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and let them give it to the workers who are in Yahweh’s house, to repair the damage to the house,

paite: Singlem bawl mite, inn lam mite, inn sia bawl mite'n inn siatna tak bawlna sing leh suangsek aleitheihna ding un, chi in va gen in, chi in TOUPA' inn ah asawl hi.
english: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.

paite: Himahleh dangka apiakte uh etpih nawn ding in agelhsak tuan kei, muanhuaitak a hih zel ahih ziak un," achi hi.
english: However, no accounting shall be asked of them for the money delivered into their hand, for they deal faithfully.”

paite: Siampu lianpen Hilkiah in laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah, "TOUPA' inn ah dan laibu ka mu,” achi hi. Hilkiah in huai laibu Shaphan apia a, ama'n asimta hi.
english: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house.” Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah laigelhmi Shaphan ava hoh a, kumpipa kiang ah thu ava tun nawn a, "Na mite'n inn a dangka omte apekhe vek ua, TOUPA' inn lam nasem mite ape vek uh," achi hi.
english: Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, “Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hands of the workmen who have the oversight of Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Laigelhmi Shaphan in, "Siampu Hilkiah in laibu ahon pia,” chi in kumpipa ahilh a, huchi in Shaphan in kumpipa ma ah asim hi.
english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered a book to me.” Then Shaphan read it before the king.

paite: Kumpipa'n dan laibu a thute azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuante abotkek hi.
english: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n siampu Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Mikaiah tapa Akbor, laigelhmi Shaphan leh kumpipa sikha Asahiah kiang ah,
english: The king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

paite: "Kei, mi tengteng leh Judah teng a ding in hiai laibu a thu tuang toh kisai in TOUPA hon dotsak un. I pi-le-pute'n hiai laibu a thute zuih ding ana ngaihkhiak louh ziak un i tung uah TOUPA thangpaihna athupi mahmah ngal a," chi in thu apia hi.
english: “Go inquire of Yahweh for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found; for great is Yahweh’s wrath that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.”

paite: Huchi in siampu Hilkiah, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan, Asahiah, puansilh kempa Harhas tapa Tikvah tapa Shallum zi zawlnei Huldah kiang ah ahoh ua, ava houpih uhi. Amah bel Jerusalem sehkhen nihna a teng ahi.
english: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter); and they talked with her.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah TOUPA, Israelte Pathian in hichi in achi, “Ka kiang a nou hon sawlpa hilh un," TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: She said to them, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

paite: "Ngai in, hiai mun ah leh asung a tengte tung ah thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding, Judah kumpipa'n laibu a, athusim tengteng bang in.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read.

paite: Kei ahon paisan ua, pathian dangte kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, akhutsuak ua ahon thangpaihsak ziak un hiai mun ah ka thangpaihna nakpitak in akuang dia, amawkmih kei ding hi.
english: Because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.’”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA thu dong ding a nou hon sawlpa Judah kumpipa kiang ah huchi in na chi ding uh. TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Na thuzakte tungtang thu ah,
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, tell him, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Concerning the words which you have heard,

paite: hiai mun leh asung a tengte hihgam leh hamsiat in a-om ding uh chih thu ka gen na zak a, na lungtang anem a, TOUPA ma a na kiniamkhiak a, na puante na bohkek a, ka ma a na kah ziak in, ke'n leng na thu ka na za, TOUPA'N achi.
english: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before Yahweh when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in ngai in, na pi-le-pute kiang ah ka hon pi dia, na han ah lungmuangtak a pi in na om dia, hiai mun a thil hoih lou ka tunsak ding tengteng na mit in amu vek kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in huai thu kumpipa kiang ah atun nawn uhi.
english: ‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place.’”’” So they brought this message back to the king.
